# Dashboard Pull Request Self-Review Template

## 1. Summary of Changes
- Detailed UI component enhancement and state persistence.

## 2. Pre-Submission Self-Review Checklist
- [ ] Requirements verified against issue specification.
- [ ] Responsive layout tested on desktop and mobile viewports.
- [ ] Zero unhandled state rejections or blank screens on network disconnection.
- [ ] 100% Green local test suite execution (`pnpm test` / `npm test`).
- [ ] Standalone issue closure tag present (`Closes #<num>`).
